$Comment: The binding row for the Great Turkey's hard fight (EncounterManager/Harvest_Feast/
Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter_Hard.json), the twin of the normal fight's row beside this file. It
names the fight with its hard name (NameKey, the hard Great Turkey's nameplate in npcs.lang, on the bar's
Records tab, the Claims it pays and every line that names it), binds the boss the library credits through
the script's Boss slot, and keeps the hard fight's records under a bucket of their own,
harvest_feast_great_turkey_hard, a boss of its own on Records' Bosses tab in the Seasonal group, split by
how many fought it (ByPartySize), so a hard win is never ranked against a normal one.
Participation and Feedback are the normal row's, so a share of the hard daily Claim is earned the same way
and the same banner and toasts teach the fight: damage to the Great Turkey (DamageDealt, the server rule's
1.0), to the Turkey Souls at its side (DamageToAdds), damage taken (DamageTaken) and every second in the
fight (Presence), each times its weight. Change a weight in both rows together.
Scale holds only Companion, as on the normal row: where MMO Mob Scaling runs, it scales the Great Turkey
with the level its souls read in the hard graveyard, health and pecks both, read once as the fight
begins. Write no other Scale leaf (its hard fight scales its health with the party itself) and no Loot
(its hard script pays its two hard Claims). Switch the row off with Enabled false, or from
